system.description:
When you tell someone of your wrongdoings, roll with the questions:

  • Do you view the other as pure of heart?

  • Do you invoke religion or family?

success.value: You feel your soul lightened; clear a condition.

partial.value:
You feel your soul lightened; clear a condition.

The person you're speaking to chooses: either you give them enough detail that they can later prove your wrongdoings, or they can immediately clear a condition.

failure.label: Miss
failure.value: Your confession unfortunately falls on the wrong ears.
